title: 7 Days Ireland Tour Package
overview:
• Walk down the quaint streets of Dublin, the capital of Ireland and explore the city’s iconic universities, sprawling parks and the embankments of River Liffey.
• 7 days Ireland Tour Package also includes a visit to the Powerscourt Estate, a 13th-century castle that is known for its stunning structure, landscaped garden and view of the Sugar Loaf Mountain.
• Head to the Rock of Cashel for getting enlightened about its historic importance and to marvel at its natural aura.
• Visit the 17th century Charles Fort to get an unperturbed view of the Atlantic Ocean.
• 7 day tour of Ireland offers Horse & Carriage Ride in the Killarney National Park bypassing panoramic view of the pristine lakes and untouched beauty.
• Spend a considerable amount of time in Adare, a picturesque village that is recognized for its heritage. Speak with the locals and get to know about the local lifestyle and culture.
• Visit the Cliff of Moher where the sound of the rolling blue waves crashes against the cliffs and makes a rhythmic sound.
• Traverse through the Burren National Park which features a unique scenery consisting of mountains, grasslands and forests.
• Gape at the ruins of Royal Abbey which belongs to the 13th century and has received the honour of being an excellent example of early Gothic Architecture.

days.title: Arrival in Ireland: The Twentieth-Largest Island On Earth
prose: Arrive in Ireland and get dropped at the hotel where you will be welcomed heartily. Today marks the 1st day of your 7 days Ireland Tour Package
Enjoy the day at leisure
Get down at the lobby and have a look at the posters which are put up on the walls to retain information about the Itinerary, Time Schedule and name of the Guides
Overnight stay at the hotel

days.title: Dublin; Local Sightseeing To Explore The City’s Heritage And Culture
prose: Take a peaceful stroll along the banks of River Liffey which flows through the heart of Dublin
Visit the old educational institutions including Trinity University
Explore the sprawling garden and high-spirited Downtown Dublin
Later, in the afternoon, spend the day at ease
Overnight stay at the hotel

days.title: Dublin to Cork: Powerscourt Gardens-Kilkenny-Rock of Cashel-Cork
prose: Flag off your 3rd day of 7 days Ireland Tour Package by heading from Dublin to Powerscourt Garden, a 13th-century castle, known for its stunning structure, landscaped garden and view of the Sugar Loaf Mountain
Next, travel to Kilkenny, a medieval city in Ireland that sits on the banks of the River Nore. In the afternoon, gorge on a sumptuous lunch and take a stroll in and around the town
Travel further south to visit the Rock of Cashel, one of the crucial historic sites in Ireland
In the mid-afternoon, arrive in Cork to look around the second-largest city in Ireland
Later, gorge on a sumptuous dinner and enjoy an overnight stay at the hotel

days.title: Cork- Limerick: Kinsale- Killarney-Adare-Limerick
prose: Wake up to a lovely Irish morning and get ready to travel to Kinsale, a charismatic town on the southern coast of Ireland. Here, we will visit the Charles Fort, a 17th-century fortress to get an unperturbed view of the Atlantic Ocean
Later, embark on your journey to Killarney, one of the leading towns in Ireland which brim with travellers
Indulge in Horse & Carriage Ride in the Killarney National Park overlooking the natural aura to reach the Ross Castle
Enjoy a Cruise Ride in the scenic lakes of the Killarney National Park to catch hold of the stunning vistas
Next, head towards Adare Village which has received the heritage tag from the Irish Government
Marvel at the medieval ecclesiastical architecture at Royal Abbey which dates back to the 13th century
Arrive in Limerick in the mid-afternoon and explore the city highlights like King John's Castle, St. John's Cathedral and the lively shopping hub
Later, gorge on a sumptuous dinner and enjoy an overnight stay at the hotel

days.title: Limerick - Galway
prose: Today, you will set off from Limerick to reach Bunratty Village and visit the Bunratty Castle and Folk Park. Get to learn about the intricate cottages and old marketplaces of Ireland and life in Ireland during the medieval era
Next, head to Caherconnell Stone Fort which belongs to the early 10th to the mid-12th century and is made of limestone
This 7 days Ireland Tour Package also includes a visit to the Poulnabrone Dolmen which belongs to the Neolithic Period(4200 BC-2900 BC)
Get to see an elaborate exhibition about Burren’s Sheepdogs
Later, proceed to visit the Cliff of Moher and O’Brien’s Tower
Traverse through the Burren National Park which features a unique scenery consisting of mountains, grasslands and forests
Arrival in Galway and check into a hotel

days.title: Galway - Dublin
prose: Today marks the last day of your Ireland Tour Package for 7 days
Pay a visit to CONG, one of the small hamlets surrounded by a panoramic lake
Explore the remnants of Royal Abbey which was founded in 1270
Take a Stroll around Ashford Castle which has been transformed into a hotel
Later, embark on a journey to Clonmacnoise which was founded in 544 and now stands as a ruined monastery
In the late afternoon, reach Dublin
Overnight Stay at hotel

days.title: Departure
prose: Check out from hotel
End your Ireland Tour Package for 7 days with a bag full of memories
